subject: Interim certification path to meet ClearHarbor vendor onboarding
messages:
From: Kaitlyn Myers <kaitlyn.myers@clearharbor.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@clearharbor.com
Date: 2026-09-14T09:12:00Z
Subject: Vendor onboarding - SOC 2 Type II request and timeline

Marcus —

Thanks for the demo yesterday. ClearHarbor's procurement team is moving the PO review faster than expected and we need a SOC 2 Type II report or an interim attestation/bridge that covers the 2025 audit period to complete our onboarding checklist. Our deadline to finalize vendor acceptance is 2026-09-20 COB (we have an internal approval meeting). If Redwood can provide either: (a) the full Type II report for the 2025 audit period, or (b) a signed interim controls attestation plus a bridge letter confirming Type II is in flight and target date, that will satisfy the procurement gate.

Attached is our vendor security questionnaire and the specific procurement checklist so you can see which items are gating. If you can confirm feasibility and estimated turnaround today, I can escalate internally. This is tied to an initial pilot (PO for $120k) and a provisional production start if we clear onboarding.

Thanks —
Kaitlyn
Senior Vendor Manager
ClearHarbor Bank

Monica / Aditya —

Heads-up: ClearHarbor needs either our 2025 Type II or an interim attestation + bridge letter to meet a vendor onboarding deadline of 2026-09-20 (they told me they can escalate). This is for a pilot tied to a $120k PO and likely expansion. Can we: 1) confirm whether Legal + Security can sign an interim controls attestation/bridge letter, and 2) list exactly which artifacts/evidence we need from Product/Infra to support a compressed turnaround?

I'm asking for an optimistic 72-hour path but will take pragmatically what we can do. Please include estimated completion time and any blocking approvals (Legal signature, auditor acknowledgment). Cc'ing Evelyn for awareness of commercial impact.

Thanks —
Marcus

> Attachments from ClearHarbor included.

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Andrew Sullivan <andrew.sullivan@thirdparty-audit.com>
Date: 2026-09-14T12:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: Vendor onboarding - SOC 2 Type II request and timeline

Marcus / Aditya —

We can provide a limited interim controls attestation and a bridge letter that summarizes: (1) the period covered by the last completed SOC 2 (Type II) engagement, (2) the scope of controls audited, (3) current controls status, and (4) our timeline to provide the formal Type II report. A few important points:

- We do NOT have a finalized SOC 2 Type II report for 2025 yet; that is still in progress with our auditor.
- Legal needs to review and sign any bridge letter / interim attestation; Legal sign-off typically adds 1–2 business days.
- If we can gather the evidence items below within 24 hours, I can generate a draft bridge + attestation within 48–72 hours and route to Legal for approval.

Minimum evidence checklist for an expedited draft (we'll accept links to artifacts in Drive):
- Control owners list mapped to control IDs (CSV or doc)
- Latest change-control runbook and one sampled PR + review evidence (merge commit + reviewer comment)
- Access management snapshot (IAM groups and admin users) as of 2026-09-01
- Recent SOC-related monitoring logs (last 90 days) and retention policy
- Incident response runbook and most recent tabletop summary
- Encryption-at-rest confirmation (encryption config screenshot or infra note)

If ClearHarbor needs auditor acknowledgment, Andrew (CC'd) can provide a short note confirming we are in an active Type II engagement and an estimated completion window, provided he receives our auditor pack.

I will start a draft template based on our standard interim wording and the Q1 2026 template in the docs link below. For the expedited path we will need: 1) Product/Infra to deliver the checklist artifacts quickly; 2) Legal to be on standby to sign; 3) Andrew to issue the auditor acknowledgement if requested.

Links: https://docs.redwood.com/templates/interim-bridge-template-v1.docx

I'll begin prep if you confirm we should push the expedited lane.

Monica Patel
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

--- Attachment: requested-scope-summary.pdf (pdf)

Monica —

Please proceed with the expedited lane. I've pinged Product and Infra to assemble the checklist items (they expect a note by EOD). Legal is on standby for signature but needs the draft first. If you can pull a bridge + interim attestation draft within 48 hours we will route for immediate sign-off.

Marcus — I'll own the communications with Kaitlyn and confirm internal commitments.

Thanks,
Aditya

Monica estimates a 48–72 hour push if artifacts arrive.

I recommend we approve the expedited route and authorize Legal to sign the interim letter with standard limited wording (we'll avoid definitive Type II claims). This will likely unblock the PO and allow us to start the pilot next week.

Happy to join a short sync if that helps.

Thanks —
